name: Science, Health and Aging Minor
intro: The science, health and aging minor is appropriate for students working toward careers in medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, biological sciences, public health or other health related fields. Admission to the minor is only available to students who have completed 4 units of prerequisites (BISC 120 or BISC 121 ) as part of their major requirements.
